tools.name: create-auth-challenge
tools.description:
Create Challenge
Generates a one-time authentication challenge for granting API access to the user's vault. Upon providing a valid app_name, the server issues a unique challenge_id and displays a 4-digit code within the Anytype Desktop app. The challenge_id must then be used with create-api-key (along with the code the user reads from the app) to retrieve an authentication token.
Error Responses:
400: Bad request
500: Internal server error

app_name.description: The name of the app that is requesting the challenge

tools.name: create-api-key
tools.description:
Create API Key
After receiving a challenge_id from create-auth-challenge, call this endpoint with the corresponding 4-digit code (displayed in Anytype Desktop) along with the challenge_id. If the code is correct, returns a new api_key that can be used to authenticate further requests.
Error Responses:
400: Bad request
500: Internal server error

challenge_id.description: The challenge id associated with the previously displayed code

code.description: The 4-digit code retrieved from Anytype Desktop app

tools.name: download-file
tools.description:
Download file
Streams the bytes of a file object, returned base64-encoded (content_base64) along with its content_type and size. For images, pass width to fetch a pre-rendered variant at that pixel width.
Error Responses:
400: Bad request
401: Unauthorized
404: Resource not found
500: Internal server error

space_id.description: The ID of the space to which the file belongs; must be retrieved from ListSpaces endpoint

file_id.description: The ID of the file to download; can be a file object ID or, for images, a raw file CID

width.description: For images only: pixel width of the pre-rendered variant to fetch; ignored for non-image files

tools.name: delete-file
tools.description:
Delete file
Removes a file object. By default the file is moved to the bin and can be restored. Pass skip_bin=true to permanently delete it instead.
